name: remote-support-app
description: Local Wi-Fi remote support for mobile devices with explicit consent

scripts.electron:dev: npm run build:server && npm run build && npm start --workspace=electron
scripts.electron:build: npm run build:server && npm run build && npm run build --workspace=electron && electron-builder
scripts.electron:pack: npm run build:server && npm run build && npm run build --workspace=electron && electron-builder --dir
